messages:
gina_support: Heads up — Sapphire customer reporting sustained 3x TPS burst after a marketing campaign. Dedicated pool started returning 429s and tail latency spiked. Anyone on call?
omar_sre: Oncall here. Can you paste example request ids + the approximate time window?
gina_support: Request ids xYz123, xYz124, window ~03:12-03:20 UTC. They reported ~12k tokens/s peak, retries didn't help. Pasting relevant log lines below.
```
2024-04-05T03:14:02Z svc: admission controller REJECT user=sapphire req_id=xYz123 reason=burst_credit_exhausted pool=sapphire-pool usage=12000 tps_headroom=9000
2024-04-05T03:14:03Z runtime: queue_delay_ms=2100 tail_lat=520 client_rtt=45
```
omar_sre: That REJECT indicates burst credits exhausted. Do they have prewarm/burst credits configured? What's their reserved T PS?
gina_support: They reserved 6k TPS; burst headroom was configured for +6k. Telemetry shows sudden ramp to 12k, and node-level GPU util hit 95% on three slots — looks like a noisy tenant grabbed capacity.
raj_eng: I can try to repro with a traffic generator. Quick question: are we seeing any admission accounting lag? Last audit mentioned a possible delay in the headroom refill loop after the recent preemptive-refill change.
megan_billing: Billing shows no recent burst credit top-up on their account. They were on an annual commit; remaining burst credits for the period were ~180k tokens before today's spike.
omar_sre: Triage plan: 1) Temporarily increase their burst credits to stop 429s; 2) Move the noisy tenant off hot slots (proj 'omega') via live migration; 3) Investigate admission refill loop & potential race causing delayed replenishment. Who can do 1 & 2 now?
gina_support: Account exec approved a temporary credit boost. @devops-bot please issue the boost: `/credits grant sapphire 200000 --reason "marketing spike emergency"`
devops-bot: Command accepted: provisional_credits=200000 expires=2024-04-06T04:00:00Z. Notifying autoscale.
autoscale-bot: Autoscale attempted scale +2 nodes to sapphire-pool; cooldown prevented immediate add due to recent failure. Error: "placement constraint: GPU quota reached in region-us-west".
raj_eng: If region quota is hit we need a fallback: route overflow to a compatible hosted variant (lower VRAM quant) or gracefully degrade. Do we have a cross-pool overflow routing policy for this customer? @omar_sre
omar_sre: We do, but it was disabled for sapphire because of strict isolation settings. I've requested a temporary privacy exception for 2 hours so we can fallback to hosted. Meanwhile I'll patch the admission refill path to double-check debit transactions and avoid the race.
megan_billing: Created ticket BILL-7891 to reconcile the temporary boost and mark invoices as disputed for manual review. Also saw a small fraction of 401s in the same window — might be auth rate limiting at the edge, filing AUTH-456.
gina_support: Customer accepted the hosted fallback under SOC2 terms. Follow-ups: raj to push refill patch, omar to monitor admission metrics + alerts, megan to confirm billing flags, gina to send postmortem. ETA for patch: ~2 hours. Any objections?
raj_eng: No objections. I'll open PR and run synthetic load tests against staging. Repro steps I'll include: 1) spawn 3 generators at ~4k TPS each, 2) inject a noisy tenant at 95% GPU on two nodes, 3) tail admission logs at /var/log/admission.log and watch for `burst_credit_exhausted` + delayed refills.
omar_sre: Added dashboard panels for `burst_credit_usage` and `admission_rejects`; alerting if rejects > 5/min. Will keep monitoring and will post links.
gina_support: :thumbsup: I'll circle back to the customer in 30m with mitigation steps and share the postmortem when ready.
